Class CommandProcessor

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.chat.cmd.CommandProcessor
public class CommandProcessor extends Object
The CommandProcessor type is the command registry for one session. The registry matches a full command name, and the longest match wins. The remainder of the line is then passed to Command.execute(CommandContext, String).

    • getCommands

      public List<Command> getCommands()
      The getCommands method returns the registered commands. The order is the order of register(Command). The returned list is the live list, so a later change to it changes the registry.
      Returns:
      The registered commands in registration order.

    • execute

      public boolean execute(CommandContext ctx, String line) throws Exception
      The execute method runs line when it matches a registered name or alias. If line is null, the method returns false. normalize(String) lowercases the line and collapses its whitespace. If that result is empty, the method returns false. findLongestMatch(String) picks the longest name or alias that matches. If nothing matches, the method returns false. A match calls Command.execute(CommandContext, String) with the remainder and then returns true. The caller formats a thrown Exception as a red error.
      Parameters:
      ctx - The shell resources for this connection.
      line - The full command line, already trimmed.
      Returns:
      true when a command ran, or false when nothing matched.
      Throws:
      Exception - The matched command threw.

    • findByName

      public Command findByName(String name)
      The findByName method looks up a command by its canonical name or an alias. help uses this lookup. If name is null, the method returns null. The comparison uses normalize(String) on the supplied name and on each registered name and alias. A null alias list is skipped. If no name or alias matches, the method returns null.
      Parameters:
      name - The user-supplied name.
      Returns:
      The matching command, or null when nothing matches.

    • findLongestMatch

      private CommandProcessor.CommandMatch findLongestMatch(String normalized)
      The findLongestMatch method chooses the longest registered name or alias. A candidate matches when the line equals that name, or when the line begins with that name and a space. Each command name is considered, and then each alias. A null alias list is skipped. A longer match replaces a shorter one. If no candidate matches, the method returns null.
      Parameters:
      normalized - The line already passed through normalize(String).
      Returns:
      The longest match, or null when nothing matches.

    • matchLength

      private int matchLength(String normalized, String name)
      The matchLength method measures one candidate name against the line. If name is null, the method returns -1. If the normalized name is empty, the method returns -1. If the line equals the name, the method returns the name length. If the line starts with the name and a space, the method returns the name length. Any other line returns -1.
      Parameters:
      normalized - The line already passed through normalize(String).
      name - The candidate name or alias.
      Returns:
      The matched character count, or -1 when the candidate does not match.

    • argsAfter

      private String argsAfter(String normalized, int nameLength)
      The argsAfter method returns the text that follows a matched name. If nameLength is negative, the method returns the empty string. If nameLength is at least the line length, the method returns the empty string. Otherwise the method returns the substring after the name, with surrounding spaces removed.
      Parameters:
      normalized - The full normalized line.
      nameLength - The matched name length.
      Returns:
      The remainder after the name.

    • normalize

      public static String normalize(String raw)
      The normalize method lowercases a line and collapses its whitespace. Leading and trailing spaces are removed first. A run of spaces or tab characters becomes one space. That space is omitted when it would be the first character. Other characters are appended in lower case.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw line.
      Returns:
      The normalized line.
